newsitem.title: CHINA: China to channel funds to laggard regions.
newsitem.headline: China to channel funds to laggard regions.

text.p: China will spur development in lagging western and central regions by channeling over 60 percent of foreign government and international agency loans there in future, a senior government official said on Wednesday.
"The state has been paying greater attention to supporting the development of central and west China," said Chen Jinhua, chairman of the State Planning Commission.

"Over the next five years, China will earmark over 60 percent of loans from international financial organisations and foreign governments for the central and western regions," he told a business conference.

He also said that Beijing would increase the proportion of policy loans to the regions, which have lagged far behind the fast-growing coastal areas. Policy credits are made to back strategic projects.
Chen gave no details of the total of expected foreign loan or domestic credits over the period.
